engine.description: Audio backend engine (e.g., alsa, dummy, net)

device.description: Audio device identifier (e.g., hw:0, hw:1, card:device)

period.description: Frames per period — smaller values reduce latency but increase CPU load

periods.description: Number of periods — determines total buffer depth (frames = period × periods)

rt_priority.description: Real-time priority level (1–99); set to 0 to disable real-time scheduling

use_hw_monitor.description: Enable hardware monitor outputs (e.g., for loopback or direct monitoring)

enable_port_check.description: Enable strict port type checking (recommended only for debugging)
